Q80. When a single-license software package is purchased by a company, which of the
 following is an activity that is usually permitted in conformity with the concept of the
 WTO’s Agreement on Trade-Related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights (TRIPS)?

choices.label: a
choices.text:
Installing the software package on a large number of computers that are used for the
 company’s business

choices.label: b
choices.text:
Making a backup copy of software for limited purposes, such as the licensee’s personal
 use or a temporary copy for maintenance

choices.label: c
choices.text:
Modifying the software package for the company’s internal use and using it on a large
 number of computers within the company

choices.label: d
choices.text:
Placing the software package on the company’s internal website so that staff members
 can download and install it
